chunks: And Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ali narrated from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan (title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim or Imam Ali al-Rida, contextually the Imam)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'mithlahu' indicate in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This entry in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* serves as a cross-reference (tarkib) within the chapter on hunting and slaughter, linking the chain of narrators from Safwan ibn Yahya to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) with a previous ruling. It highlights the scholarly practice of consolidating similar jurisprudential opinions to avoid redundancy while preserving the specific isnad (chain of transmission) for verification. This reinforces the continuity of the Imami school of thought regarding the permissibility and conditions of hunting.
